description:
Your team, or team null: its name, pool (credits), seats, each member's name and role.
    The owner also sees every member's email, monthly cap and spend, open invites (never
    their links) and the newest 50 charges to the pool (who, what kind, credits, when; never
    what it was about). your_credits is your own balance, untouched while you are a member.
    Free. Same as GET /v1/team.
name: get_team
